Art for the masses.
Bought by the brave.

I paint abstract, expressionistic work in loud colors. Not because I'm cheerful. Because subtlety can be dishonest.

I don't start with concepts, sketches, or a comforting plan. I start when something refuses to stay quiet. The canvas is not a safe space — it's a negotiation that usually escalates.

Color is doing the heavy lifting. It carries tension, irritation, clarity, and the occasional bad mood. If a painting feels balanced, it's probably lying. I'm not interested in harmony; I'm interested in pressure.

Music is always present. It is the music that inspires me. Always.

Presented by Fredrik & September
